# `apps/realmforge/interactions/RealmForgeObjectStateDocument.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/apps/realmforge/interactions/RealmForgeObjectStateDocument.js`

Saved instance state is separate from the generated design's rest geometry.

### `prepareRealmForgeObjectState(session, { assemblyResourceId, state, expectedSnapshot = session?.documentSnapshot } = {})`

A prepared save is private authority: serialized data cannot be replayed as a commit.

### `async commitRealmForgeObjectState(session, prepared, { sourceGuard = null, signal = null, label = 'Save object interactions' } = {})`

### `realmForgeObjectStateEqual(left, right)`

### `projectRealmForgeObjectStateAssembly(assembly, state, { includeMechanisms = false } = {})`

Detached rendering/physics input. Mechanism coordinates are restored by the native solver hook, so their frame conventions are never reauthored here.

### `reconcileRealmForgeObjectStatePlacement(snapshot, { beforeAssembly, afterAssembly } = {})`

Include these operations in the SAME guarded storage transaction as the new assembly. Explicit relocation rebases saved poses instead of allowing an old world-space pose to pull an object back after reopen. Fit/path checks must use projectRealmForgeObjectStateAssembly before preparing that relocation.
